iac.review:
Faculty Review: IAC
Class explanation style: Class-e kono topic ekbar bujhiyei chere dey. Kew jodi second time explain korte bole, seta uni bhalo vabe ney na. Ejonno onek student class-e confused hoye pore.
Reaction to questions: Class-e question korle onek shomoy mejaj kharap kore felen. Eitar jonno student ra freely question korte bhoy pay.
Report workload: Normal report er naam e onek heavy kaj dey, almost thesis level. Time pressure onek beshi hoy.
Teaching method: Class-e poranor flow clear na. Ekta question diye arekta te chole jan, tai concept properly build hoy na.
Marking system: Negative marking use kore, ja onek student er marks khub beshi kome jabar karon hoy.
Behavior with students: Overall behavior kind ba cordial mone hoy na. Supportive vibe kom.
Learning outcome: Effort deyar poro practical vabe beshi kichu shikha jay na bole onek student feel kore.
Grading fairness: Grading system fair mone hoy na. Usually curve apply kore na, jar karone overall result kharap hoy.
Partiality issue: Kichu selected student er dike beshi favor thakar impression ase.
Overall impression: Course ta mentally stressful, pressure beshi, learning comparatively kom. Strong self-study chara cope kora tough.
